description: This file defines the 'DocumentsPage' React component for the frontend web application. It manages UI for uploading documents, viewing a document library, and associated state handling, including API interactions for listing and uploading documents. It includes components for document status display, tenant ID input, file upload, and document listing with refresh capability.

methods.name: normalizeDocumentStatus
methods.description: Converts backend document status strings into UI-friendly badges ('processed', 'processing', etc.).

methods.name: StatusBadge
methods.description: React component that renders a styled status badge based on document status.
